description: This file defines a class RetrievePolicyEntryStrategy which is responsible for handling the RetrievePolicyEntry command within a policy persistence strategy. It extends an abstract class and implements method logic for retrieving a specific policy entry based on a label, returning the result or an error if not found.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyEntryStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a strategy for retrieving a specific policy entry based on a label, handling commands of type RetrievePolicyEntry.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to retrieve a policy entry by label, returning a result containing the entry or an error if not found.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag for cache validation based on the specified policy entry.
